title: Judie S NDE 8508
content: As I was slipping out of consciousness, it was as if a curtain of light were descending. I remember how surreal it was to realize how dark our world generally is. I'm not sure how to describe this, but I could see the world from above—and it was as if a veil had been lifted that made everything very clear and vivid. I rose up out of the darkness of the world and ascended into a very peaceful, painless, and uplifting reality. There were others there whom I could not see, but I did feel their presence. I could see where I was going to have to go next, but heard a voice in my mind telling me it was not time yet. Suddenly, I was back in this world and noticed how really painful it was. I felt very angry they brought me back. Then one of the nurses reminded me that I will soon have a baby who will need me. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 06/08/1994 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was giving birth to my child. It was an emergency C-section during to breech presentation and pre-eclampsia. When the Anesthesiologist injected the epidural, she accidentally put it into a vein. I remember seeing my blood pressure monitor read 40/20 and I knew it was over before I slipped out of consciousness. How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I saw and heard what everyone in the room was doing. The anesthesiologist grabbing the reversal and pressor medication. I clearly left my body and existed outside it. [Medical notes: "A vasopressor agent or pressor, is any antihypotensive medication that tends to raise reduced blood pressure." and "Reversal agents are defined as any drug used to reverse the effects of certain medications." Slightly word order alteration in online information sources: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov and https://physionet.org] How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. It was as if everything was known and that was normal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Probably at the point I was slipping off. I was aware of everything going on in the room and even what my physical status was. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Apparently, this lasted only seconds, but I had time to walk around a bit while there. Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I am near sighted, everything was crystal clear and detailed. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear the thoughts of others. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes More like ascending into a bright world. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The light descended and unveiled a better place. I could see the divide as I was going. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. I could walk about, but my eyes had not adjusted to the brightness. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I remember being fascinated with the fact of how much pain my body actually has after I was out of it. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian I was raised in a Southern Baptist and in a Holiness environment. At this point in my life, I began working with a local Shaman. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I embraced learning pagan and alternative teachings. My beliefs are very eclectic. What is your religion now? Other faiths- Unitarian and other liberal faiths I have since completed energy mastery school, and have become educated in alternative healing practices. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. It was not what I learned in a Christian church. What I encountered did not judge me, only offered love and acceptance. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I know that the judgment I was taught as a child does not exist. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify I knew there were others there, but did not see them. I clearly heard a voice in my head telling me it was not my time. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes There was a presence felt that was a higher being. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists. I have no doubt that there is some type of existence after we shed our bodies. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The was an all-encompassing love and acceptance. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I began studies of multiple religions and alternative healing modalities. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes The Native American's have a saying that once you have no fear of death, nothing can hurt you. Note also that the words 'death' and 'change' can be interchangeable. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes There is absolutely no way I can ever put into words how wonderful to other side is. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I can still see it. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I've always had them, but undeveloped. Now, after years of study, I have some abilities I do not reveal so as to not frighten folks. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I did not at first. After becoming a nurse, I have used my experience to bring comfort to families of the dying. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Over the course of my life, I have had many, many experiences with death that cannot be explained. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? No. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Seemed pretty thorough.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She described rising/ascending out of the darkness of the world into a peaceful, painless reality; and noticing how painful the body felt when back.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: More like ascending into a bright world.

arrival.other_being_detail: She felt the presence of others she could not see, and a higher presence; she heard an unidentifiable voice in her mind saying it was not her time.

environment.environment_other_detail: A very bright, peaceful, painless, uplifting reality; her eyes had not adjusted to the brightness; described as a clearly mystical/unearthly realm and a 'better place' unveiled by descending light.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Emergency C-section for breech presentation and pre-eclampsia; epidural accidentally injected into a vein; blood pressure dropped to 40/20 before loss of consciousness.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Raised Southern Baptist and Holiness; at that point working with a local Shaman.
person_demographics.occupation: Nurse (later; stated she became a nurse after the NDE).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Curtain/veil of light descending; sense of others present but unseen; heard thoughts of others; strong contrast in pain upon return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with elevated viewpoint and heightened clarity occurred as a 'curtain of light' descended; then ascent into bright realm; barrier/limit and message 'not time yet'; sudden return.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She reported everything happening at once/time stopping, while also being aware of the room and her physical status.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She reported hearing the thoughts of others during the OBE; and described a 'curtain of light' descending and a veil lifting that made everything crystal clear.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “As I was slipping out of consciousness, it was as if a curtain of light were descending.” “I could see the world from above—and it was as if a veil had been lifted that made everything very clear and vivid.” “I could see where I was going to have to go next, but heard a voice in my mind telling me it was not time yet.”
